input.title: 2024 Old Town Sportsman BigWater ePDL+ 132
input.descriptionHtml:
Ask about deferred interest financing!

Embark on a journey of unparalleled freedom and versatility with the Old Town Sportsman BigWater ePDL+ 132. Engineered to redefine the boundaries of kayak fishing, this powerhouse of innovation delivers an exceptional blend of performance, convenience, and adaptability.

At the heart of the Old Town Sportsman BigWater ePDL+ 132 lies its patented ePDL+ power-assisted pedal drive system. Seamlessly switch between manual pedal, power-assisted pedal, or fully motorized cruise control with five-speed settings and integrated cruise control functionality. Whether you crave the tranquility of manual pedaling or the swift efficiency of motorized propulsion, the choice is yours at the touch of a button.

Equipped with a compact yet potent 36V 20Ah Li-Ion battery, the ePDL+ Drive ensures reliable power for extended excursions, while the intuitive control buttons and sunglasses-friendly screen offer effortless navigation and monitoring of your propulsion settings.

Designed for the discerning angler, the Old Town Sportsman BigWater ePDL+ 132 boasts a host of features tailored to enhance your fishing experience. A redesigned stern tankwell accommodates various crates and coolers, while two accessory tracks and drillable mounting plates provide endless customization options for your favorite fishing gear. Non-slip EVA foam deck pads ensure stability and comfort, while a transducer mount simplifies fish finder installation for optimal angling efficiency.

Storage is plentiful with dry storage compartments in the sealed bow hatch and drive console, ensuring your gear stays protected and organized throughout your journey. Plus, the removable ePDL+ Drive and Seat facilitate easy transport and storage, allowing you to seamlessly transition from land to water and back again.

Crafted from rugged single-layer polyethylene, the Old Town Sportsman BigWater ePDL+ 132 offers durability and reliability, backed by a total weight capacity of 500 lbs.

Elevate your fishing adventures to new heights with the Old Town Sportsman BigWater ePDL+ 132. Whether you're chasing trophy fish or exploring remote waterways, this versatile kayak empowers you to embrace the freedom of the open water on your terms.

Patented ePDL+ power-assisted pedal drive with 5-speed settings and cruise control Compact, powerful 36V 20Ah Li-Ion battery and charger included Control buttons and polarized sunglasses-friendly screen integrated directly into the ePDL+ Drive Redesigned stern tankwell optimized for a variety of crates and coolers Two accessory tracks and two drillable mounting plates for easy accessory mounting Non-slip EVA foam deck pads provide traction and stand-up comfort Transducer mount for easy installation of your fish finder Dry storage in the sealed bow hatch and additional dry storage in the drive console ePDL+ Drive and Seat are removable for easy transport and storage
